title: HSK 3.23 · 题目, 客观, 老百姓, 理发
focus: 录音 · 客观 · 香蕉 · 旅馆 · 发达 · 普遍 · 形状 · 干吗 · 美食 · 散步 · 大夫 · 歌声 · 束 · 性别 · 气候 · 规范 · 歌迷 · 题目 · 跑步 · 老太太 · 老百姓 · 果汁 · 标题 · 职工 · 木头 · 美术 · 武术 · 广大 · 收音机 · 专题 · 工夫 · 旅行社 · 大使馆 · 做客 · 理发 · 普及 · 试题 · 积极性 · 老头儿 · 空儿
body:
Topics, songs and everyday people: 题 "topic, question" builds four words, 老 makes the friendly words for old folk, and 馆 is any public building. Two words switch readings: 发 is fà (hair) in 理发, and 大夫 is dàifu when it means doctor.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 题 | tí | topic, question (页 head + 是 shì phonetic) | 题目, 标题, 专题, 试题 |
| 老 | lǎo | old | 老太太, 老百姓, 老头儿 |
| 歌 | gē | song (欠 open mouth) | 歌声, 歌迷 |
| 音 | yīn | sound | 录音, 收音机 |
| 普 | pǔ | general, universal | 普遍, 普及 |
| 术 | shù | skill, art | 美术, 武术 |
| 馆 | guǎn | building, hall (饣 + 官 guān phonetic) | 旅馆, 大使馆 |
| 步 | bù | step | 散步, 跑步 |
| 旅 | lǚ | travel | 旅馆, 旅行社 |

## Watch out

- 理发 is lǐ**fà**: 发 fà = hair, fā = send, develop (发达).
- 散步 is **sàn**bù (stroll); 散 is sǎn when it means loose.
- 束 bundle vs 东 east vs 来 come: 束 is 木 with 口 tied around the middle.
- 工夫, 大夫, 老太太 end light: gōngfu, dàifu, lǎotàitai.

cards.Example: 上课可以录音吗？ shàngkè kěyǐ lùyīn ma: can I record the class?
cards.Notes: 录 record, copy down + 音 sound = record sound

cards.Example: 你要客观一点。 nǐ yào kèguān yìdiǎn: try to be objective
cards.Notes: 客 guest + 观 view = the guest's (outsider's) view, so objective; mirror is 主观

cards.Example: 我想吃香蕉。 wǒ xiǎng chī xiāngjiāo: I want a banana
cards.Notes: 香 fragrant + 蕉 plantain (艹 plant + 焦 jiāo for sound) = banana

cards.Example: 这家旅馆很便宜。 zhè jiā lǚguǎn hěn piányi: this hotel is cheap
cards.Notes: 旅 travel + 馆 building, lodge = travelers' lodge

cards.Example: 这里交通很发达。 zhèlǐ jiāotōng hěn fādá: transport here is well developed
cards.Notes: 发 develop, send out + 达 reach = fully developed

cards.Example: 这种情况很普遍。 zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng hěn pǔbiàn: this is very common
cards.Notes: 普 general, universal + 遍 everywhere (辶 + 扁 phonetic) = all over

cards.Example: 这块石头形状很怪。 zhè kuài shítou xíngzhuàng hěn guài: this rock has an odd shape
cards.Notes: 形 form + 状 shape, appearance = shape

cards.Meaning: why, what for; what are you doing
cards.Example: 你干吗不去？ nǐ gànmá bú qù: why aren't you going?
cards.Notes: 干 gàn do + 吗 (here má, 'what') = do what, why; also written 干嘛

cards.Example: 这里有很多美食。 zhèlǐ yǒu hěn duō měishí: there's lots of great food here
cards.Notes: 美 beautiful + 食 food = fine food

cards.Example: 饭后去散步吧。 fàn hòu qù sànbù ba: let's take a walk after dinner
cards.Notes: 散 sàn scatter, loosen + 步 step = loose, idle steps, a stroll

cards.Example: 大夫说我没事。 dàifu shuō wǒ méi shì: the doctor says I'm fine
cards.Notes: 大 + 夫 man; read dàifu for 'doctor' (dàfū is an old title for officials)

cards.Example: 她的歌声很美。 tā de gēshēng hěn měi: her singing is beautiful
cards.Notes: 歌 song + 声 sound, voice = sound of singing

cards.Example: 他送我一束花。 tā sòng wǒ yí shù huā: he gave me a bunch of flowers
cards.Notes: 束 = 木 wood with 口 a cord tied round it: a bundle; lookalikes 东, 来

cards.Example: 请写上你的性别。 qǐng xiě shang nǐ de xìngbié: please write your gender
cards.Notes: 性 nature, sex (忄 heart + 生 shēng phonetic) + 别 distinguish = sex distinction

cards.Example: 这里气候很好。 zhèlǐ qìhòu hěn hǎo: the climate here is nice
cards.Notes: 气 air, weather + 候 season, time = climate

cards.Example: 他的发音很规范。 tā de fāyīn hěn guīfàn: his pronunciation is standard
cards.Notes: 规 rule (compass) + 范 model, pattern = norm

cards.Example: 她是周杰伦的歌迷。 tā shì Zhōu Jiélún de gēmí: she's a Jay Chou fan
cards.Notes: 歌 song + 迷 lost in, obsessed = someone lost in songs, a fan

cards.Example: 这个题目太难了。 zhège tímù tài nán le: this question is too hard
cards.Notes: 题 topic, question + 目 item, heading = title, question

cards.Example: 我每天早上跑步。 wǒ měitiān zǎoshang pǎobù: I jog every morning
cards.Notes: 跑 run (⻊ foot + 包 bāo phonetic) + 步 step = jog

cards.Example: 那位老太太很友好。 nà wèi lǎotàitai hěn yǒuhǎo: that old lady is friendly
cards.Notes: 老 old + 太太 lady, Mrs. = old lady (polite)

cards.Example: 老百姓都很高兴。 lǎobǎixìng dōu hěn gāoxìng: ordinary folks are all happy
cards.Notes: 老 + 百 hundred + 姓 surname = the 'hundred surnames', common people

cards.Example: 我要一杯果汁。 wǒ yào yì bēi guǒzhī: I'd like a juice
cards.Notes: 果 fruit + 汁 juice (氵 liquid + 十 shí phonetic) = fruit juice

cards.Example: 这篇文章的标题是什么？ zhè piān wénzhāng de biāotí shì shénme: what's the article's title?
cards.Notes: 标 mark, label + 题 title = heading

cards.Example: 公司有一百个职工。 gōngsī yǒu yìbǎi ge zhígōng: the company has 100 staff
cards.Notes: 职 job, post (耳 + 只) + 工 worker = employees

cards.Example: 这是木头做的。 zhè shì mùtou zuò de: this is made of wood
cards.Notes: 木 tree, wood + 头 noun suffix (light tone)

cards.Example: 我喜欢美术课。 wǒ xǐhuan měishù kè: I like art class
cards.Notes: 美 beauty + 术 skill, art = fine arts

cards.Example: 他从小学武术。 tā cóng xiǎo xué wǔshù: he's studied martial arts since a kid
cards.Notes: 武 martial (止 + 戈 spear) + 术 skill = martial arts, kung fu

cards.Example: 广大市民都同意。 guǎngdà shìmín dōu tóngyì: the general public agrees
cards.Notes: 广 wide + 大 big = vast, the broad (masses)

cards.Example: 爷爷有一台收音机。 yéye yǒu yì tái shōuyīnjī: grandpa has a radio
cards.Notes: 收 receive + 音 sound + 机 machine = sound-receiving machine

cards.Example: 今天的专题是环保。 jīntiān de zhuāntí shì huánbǎo: today's special topic is the environment
cards.Notes: 专 special, focused + 题 topic = special topic

cards.Example: 一会儿工夫就好了。 yíhuìr gōngfu jiù hǎo le: it'll be done in no time
cards.Notes: 工 work + 夫 man, laborer = labor, and the time it takes; light tone fu

cards.Example: 我们找旅行社吧。 wǒmen zhǎo lǚxíngshè ba: let's go through a travel agency
cards.Notes: 旅行 travel + 社 society, agency (礻 + 土) = travel agency

cards.Example: 我去大使馆办签证。 wǒ qù dàshǐguǎn bàn qiānzhèng: I'm going to the embassy for a visa
cards.Notes: 大使 ambassador (大 great + 使 envoy) + 馆 building = embassy

cards.Example: 欢迎来我家做客。 huānyíng lái wǒ jiā zuòkè: you're welcome to visit us
cards.Notes: 做 be, act as + 客 guest = be someone's guest

cards.Example: 我要去理发。 wǒ yào qù lǐfà: I need a haircut
cards.Notes: 理 tidy, put in order + 发 fà hair = tidy the hair

cards.Example: 手机已经很普及了。 shǒujī yǐjīng hěn pǔjí le: phones are everywhere now
cards.Notes: 普 general, universal + 及 reach = reach everyone

cards.Example: 这些试题不难。 zhèxiē shìtí bù nán: these test questions aren't hard
cards.Notes: 试 test + 题 question = test question

cards.Example: 大家的积极性很高。 dàjiā de jījíxìng hěn gāo: everyone is very motivated
cards.Notes: 积极 active, positive (积 accumulate + 极 extreme) + 性 quality = enthusiasm

cards.Example: 那个老头儿很有意思。 nàge lǎotóur hěn yǒu yìsi: that old guy is fun
cards.Notes: 老 old + 头 head + 儿 (erhua) = old fellow; tóu keeps its tone here

cards.Example: 你明天有空儿吗？ nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòngr ma: are you free tomorrow?
cards.Notes: 空 kòng empty, free (穴 hole + 工 gōng phonetic) + 儿 = spare time; kōng is 'sky, empty'
